title: Brindlewick Bakery website relaunch: four choices before launch

decided.title: Online ordering
decided.answer: Pickup orders only at launch; delivery follows once the fee is set

decisions.title: Homepage hero
decisions.question: Which homepage hero layout should the new site launch with?
decisions.context: Both mockups use the same photo, headline and Order for pickup button; only the layout differs.

recommendation.why: The split layout keeps the headline readable on any photo and puts the order button above the fold on a phone.

options.label: Split: photo left, text right
options.caption: Photo and headline side by side

decisions.title: Returns policy
decisions.question: Should the site's returns policy use the new wording?
decisions.context: The change allows refunds for a day instead of exchanges only, and names the receipt as the proof.

recommendation.why: Customers asked for refunds at the counter most weeks, and a one-day window keeps the cost small.

evidence.before: Baked goods can be exchanged on the day of purchase. We do not offer refunds.
evidence.after: Baked goods can be exchanged or refunded within one day of purchase. Please bring your receipt.
evidence.rule_now: Baked goods can be exchanged or refunded within one day of purchase. Please bring your receipt.

decisions.title: Delivery fee
decisions.question: Which delivery fee should the site charge?
decisions.context: Delivery starts four weeks after launch; the fee can be changed later without rebuilding the site.

recommendation.why: Free delivery over $25 brings the most orders, and an order of that size covers the courier's cost.

evidence.source: Projection from the last twelve weeks of orders and the customer survey

decisions.title: Opening hours
decisions.question: Which opening hours should the site and the shop door show?
decisions.context: The shop door sign and the site footer both show whichever hours are picked.

recommendation.why: The early option opens when the commuter rush passes the shop and closes once the bread sells out.
